blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en: Table 1 compares Rufus-Air with three models measured under our harness. GLM-4.5-Air and INTELLECT-3 are two other post-trainings of the same base checkpoint, so differences against them isolate the recipe; Nemotron-3-Super is a different base at similar active-parameter scale and the strongest of the three baselines we measure. The six developer-reported columns are reference points only (Appendix D ). The Tau2-Bench rows are measured under the Claude Sonnet 5 user simulator; Appendix F shows how much the simulator alone moves them.
blocks.zh: 表1比较了Rufus-Air和在我们操纵下测得的三种模型. GLM-4.5-Air和INTELECT-3是同一基地检查站的另外两个训练后,因此与之不同的是将食谱隔离;Nemotron-3-Super是一个不同的基地,具有相似的主动参数尺度,是我们测量的三个基线中最强的. 6个开发商报告的栏目仅为参考点(附录D. Tau2-Bench行是在克劳德·索内5用户模拟器下测量的;附录F显示了模拟器单独移动它们的程度.

blocks.en: Against the two same-base models, Rufus-Air leads on every row except Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing, where GLM-4.5-Air is ahead. The lead is within two points on AIME 26 and GPQA against GLM-4.5-Air and on FrontierScience Olympiad against INTELLECT-3, and widest on instruction following, Tau2-Telecom, the Search Agent rows, and both Coding Agent rows.
blocks.zh: 面对两个同基模型,Rufus-Air领先于每排,除了Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing,GLM-4.5-Air领先. 领先者在AIME 26和GPQA对GLM-4.5-Air和Frontier Science Olympiad对INTELECT-3的两分之内,在后面的指令上最为广泛,Tau2-Telecom,搜索代理行,以及两个编码代理行.

blocks.en: Against Nemotron-3-Super, Rufus-Air is ahead on IFBench, IFEval, Multi-challenge, and Arena-Hard v2 Hard Prompt, on LiveCodeBench, Tau2-Telecom, MCP-Atlas, all three Search Agent rows, and SWE-bench Verified; within two points on AIME 25, AIME 26, GPQA, both FrontierScience tracks, Tau2-Retail, and Terminal-Bench 2.1; and behind on Creative Writing and, by two points, on Tau2-Airline. The separation is in instruction following and agentic behavior, where the recipe spends most of its stages (§ 2.1 ), rather than in mathematics or science.
blocks.zh: Rufus-Air在IF Bench、IFEval、Multi-Challenge和Arena-Hard v2 Hard Expect、LiveCode Bench、Tau2-Telecom、MCP-Atlas三条搜索代理行和SWE-bench验证中领先;在AIME 25、AIME 26、GPQA的两分之内,同时是Frontier Science轨迹、Tau2-Retail和Terminal-Bench 2.1;在创作和Tau2-Airline的两分之后。 分离是在跟随和代理行为的指示中,食谱花在大部分阶段(§2.1),而不是在数学或科学中.

blocks.en: Creative Writing is the one row on which Rufus-Air trails both GLM-4.5-Air and Nemotron-3-Super. RLHF raised both Arena-Hard v2 splits (Table 14 ; Hard Prompt by + 6.0 +6.0 , Creative Writing by + 14.4 +14.4 ), and we have not tried a reward model tuned for style.
blocks.zh: Creative Writing是Rufus-Air追踪GLM-4.5-Air和Nemotron-3-Super的一行. RLHF将Arena-Hard v2的分数都提高了(表14;Hard Point by + 6.0 + 6.0, Creative Writing by + 14.4 + 14.4),我们还没有尝试过一种按风格调整的奖励模式.

blocks.en: Table 2 (§ 3 ) reads the same recipe from the inside: one row per checkpoint in pipeline order, each carrying the benchmarks its stage targets and the change against the row above. Because each stage’s change is read from a pair of adjacent rows taken from that stage’s own result table, a value should be compared with the row directly above it rather than with the same column several stages away. Four details matter for that reading. The LiveCodeBench v6 and Tau2-Retail cells in the stage rows keep the protocol of their source tables and are not directly comparable with the GLM-4.5-Air and Rufus-Air rows, which use the protocol of Table 1 (Tables 8 and 10 ). The SFT row is measured against the public GLM-4.5-Air release, not the base model it starts from (Table 4 ). The final row is the RLHF checkpoint; Terminal-Bench 2.1, SWE-bench Verified, and Seal-0 were measured only at their own stage and at that checkpoint, so their stage-to-final differences (40.2 vs. 42.7, 67.8 vs. 65.6, 54.0 vs. 51.4) span every stage in between and are not attributed to any one of them. The IF RL checkpoint appears in Tables 9 and 10 with different measurements (GPQA 71.1 and 73.36, IFEval 94.5 and 94.73); the text cites the later one.
blocks.zh: 表2(§ 3)从内部读取相同的配方:每个检查站按管线顺序排行,每个检查站都带有其阶段目标的基准,以及相对于上行的变化。 由于每个阶段的变化都从该阶段本身的结果表的一对相邻的行读取,因此应该将一个值与其直接上方的行进行对比,而不是与相隔几个阶段的同一列进行比较。 4个细节对阅读很重要。 LiveCode Bench v6和Tau2-Retail细胞在舞台列中保留其源表的协议,与使用表1(表8和10)的协议的GLM-4.5-Air和Rufus-Air列不直接可比. SFT行是对照公开的GLM-4.5-Air发行量来衡量的,而不是它从(表4)开始的基准模型. 最后一行是RLHF检查站;终端-Bench 2.1、SWE-bench验证,和Seal-0只在他们自己的阶段和该检查站进行测量,因此,他们的阶段到最后的差额(40.2对42.7、67.8对65.6、54.0对51.4)在它们之间的每个阶段都存在,而且不归结于其中任何一个阶段。 IFL检查站载于表9和表10,测量标准各不相同(GPQA 71.1和73.36,IFEval 94.5和94.73);案文引用了后面的检查站。

blocks.en: Every stage moves its own target. The largest single-stage moves are Multi-challenge under IF RL ( + 24.7 +24.7 ), Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing under RLHF ( + 14.4 +14.4 ), and Tau2-Retail under General Agent ( + 9.8 +9.8 ); the Coding Agent run, which ended at its compute budget (§ 3.6 ), moves least ( + 1.4 +1.4 and + 2.2 +2.2 ). The one Reasoning RL benchmark that does not rise is AIME, which that stage treated as a guardrail rather than a target: each year has 30 problems, so the 2.6–2.8-point change is less than one problem’s worth and not meaningful (§ 3.2 ). The non-target benchmarks each stage monitors are in the per-stage tables, where they hold within about a point or rise; the largest drop is AIME 25, − 1.2 -1.2 across IF RL (Table 9 ).
blocks.zh: 每个阶段都会移动自己的目标. 最大的单阶段动作是IF RL(+ 24.7 + 24.7 ) 、 Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing under RLHF(+ 14.4 + 14.4 ) 和 General Agent(+ 9.8 + 9.8 ) 下的 Tau2-零售(+ 9.6 + 9.8 ) ; 编码代理运行以计算预算结束,移动最小(+ 1.4 + 1.4 和 + 2.2 +2.2 ) 。 不上升的一个理性RL基准是AIME, 该阶段被视为护栏而非目标:每年有30个问题,因此2.6-2.8点变化比一个问题的价值低,没有意义(§ 3.2 ). 非目标基准的每个阶段显示器都放在每个阶段的表格中,在大约一个点内或上升;最大的下降是全IF RL的AIME 25,− 1.2-1.2(表9)。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: The stage sections report what each stage did. This section collects the overall findings that span stages and the limits of what the recipe shows.
blocks.zh: 阶段部分报告每个阶段都做了些什么。 本节收集了跨阶段的总体调查结果和食谱显示的限度。

blocks.en: SFT does more than set the output format. Before any RL, SFT checkpoint 3799 already leads the public GLM-4.5-Air release, which includes RL, on IFEval ( + 5.3 +5.3 ), IFBench ( + 24.2 +24.2 ), and both AIME years ( + 6.6 +6.6 and + 3.5 +3.5 ), trailing only on GPQA ( − 5.7 -5.7 ; Table 4 ). This is the floor the RL stages start from (§ 3.1 ).
blocks.zh: SFT所做的不只是设置输出格式. 在任何RL之前,SFT检查站3799已经在IFEval(+ 5.3+5.3),IFBench(+ 24.2+24.2),以及AIME两个年份(+6.6+6.6和+3.5+3.5)的公众GLM-4.5-Air释放(包括RL),仅低于GPQA(−5.7-5.7;表4)。 这是RL阶段从(第3.1节)开始的地板。

blocks.en: Every outcome-reward RL stage keeps only prompts the current policy can learn from, in one of two forms. Before training, the stages drop prompts that are too easy: Reasoning RL and IF RL drop those solved more than 80% of the time, Coding RL those solved by all four warm-up samples, and General Agent those solved reliably; Reasoning RL and General Agent also drop prompts never solved, while Coding RL keeps them (§ 3.2 , § 3.3 , § 3.4 , § 3.5 ). During training, Reasoning RL keeps filtering online, admitting only groups whose mean reward lies in ( 0.0 , 0.8 ] (0.0,0.8] , and General Agent and Coding Agent drop all-pass and all-fail groups by DAPO-style dynamic sampling; Coding RL does not re-filter.
blocks.zh: 每个结果奖励RL阶段都只能以两种形式之一促使现行政策学习。 在训练前,阶段下降的提示太容易:使RL和IFR降低80%以上的解答时间,将所有四个加热样品所解答的RL编码,将General Agent可靠解答; 使RL和General Agent也下降的提示从未解答,而编码RL保留(§3.2,§3.3,§3.4,§3.5). 在训练期间,Reasoning RL持续在线过滤,只接收其平均奖励位于(0.0,0.8](0.0,0.8)的团体,而General Agent和编码Agent通过DAPO风格的动态采样将所有通过和所有失败的团体放下;Coding RL不重新过滤.

blocks.en: The pipeline orders stages by how exposed their reward is to hacking: Reasoning RL and Coding RL run first and the preference reward of RLHF runs last, with IF RL placed early because its target is close to what the policy already does (§ 2.1 ). In this order, the stages that follow Reasoning RL keep its reasoning gains: the next two leave GPQA and AIME 26 within a point of where they found them (73.5 → \to 73.36 and 87.4 → \to 87.08; Tables 6 and 10 ) while adding the targeted skills. Two readings qualify this: the intermediate Coding RL checkpoint reads 67.9 on GPQA (Table 9 ), and the IF RL checkpoint carries different GPQA values in two stage tables (71.1 and 73.36; § 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 管线命令分几个阶段, 合理RL和编码RL先跑,RLHF的优待奖励最后跑,IFRL早放,因为其目标接近政策已经做的事情(第2.1节)。 按照这个顺序,Reasoning RL之后的各个阶段保持其推理成果:接下来的两个阶段在发现GPQA和AIME 26(73.5~~~~到73.36和87.4~~到87.08;表6和10)时,保留了它们,同时增加了目标技能. 两种读数都符合这一条件:中间编码RL检查点在GPQA上读作67.9(表9),IFRL检查点在两个阶段表(71.1和73.36;§5.2)中带有不同的GPQA值.

blocks.en: We build on public, established components rather than a new framework: training runs on Rufus-Slime, our adaptation of Slime (from the group that released GLM-4.5), with Megatron-LM and SGLang underneath (§ 4.1 ). Even on this stack, details that reports rarely give still matter, such as large rollout batches for group-relative advantages and Rollout Routing Replay for the MoE policy. The agent stages needed more on top of it, which Rufus-Gym supplies (§ 4.2 ): token-in/token-out rollouts that keep multi-turn trajectories exactly on-policy, chat template handling kept consistent from SFT through the agent stages, sandboxes that hold state for the full length of a coding trajectory, and environment actors distributed across nodes so that CPU-heavy tool execution and reward computation do not contend.
blocks.zh: 我们以公共、既定的组成部分而不是一个新的框架为基础:在Rufus-Slime上开展培训,我们对Slime(来自发布GLM-4.5的团体)的修改,下面是威震天-LM和SGLang(第4.1节)。 即使在这堆东西上,报告很少给出的细节仍然很重要,如为集团相对优势而大量推出批次,以及为教育部政策而推出的Routing Replay. 代理阶段需要更多的顶端,Rufus-Gym提供(§4.2):使多回合轨迹保持精确政策状态的代号内/托肯推出,通过代理阶段从SFT保持一致的聊天模板处理,在编码轨迹全长时保持状态的沙盒,以及分布在节点的环境角色,这样CPU重度工具执行和奖励计算就不会发生争吵.

blocks.en: The agent stages add costs outside the GPU cluster. Coding Agent holds a sandbox for the full length of each trajectory and runs a test suite inside it for the reward (§ 3.6 , § 4.2 ); the sandbox service behind it is sized for on the order of ten thousand concurrent sandboxes, and maintaining it costs on the order of $10K per month. Search Agent pays per external call: at about 100 tool calls per question, a single pass over BrowseComp’s 1,266 questions makes on the order of 10 5 10^{5} search and page-extraction calls and costs a few hundred dollars at list prices ($2 per 1K Serper searches [ 88 ] , $0.05 per 1M Jina Reader tokens [ 44 ] ). Training instead uses a lower-cost internal search backend, and every training rollout is also scored by an LLM judge (§ 3.7 ). A team planning the RL stages on 8–32 nodes should budget these stages separately rather than by a per-stage average.
blocks.zh: 代理阶段会在GPU集群之外增加成本. 编码代理持有每个轨迹全长的沙盒,并在其中运行一个测试套房以获得奖励(第3.6节,第4.2节);其后面的沙盒服务大小大约为一万个并存的沙盒,并按每月10K美元的价格维持. 每一次外部通话,搜索代理付费:每次询问约100次,浏览器Company的1 266次提问,顺序为10 5 10============================================================================================================================================================================================================================ 读者信条 [44]. 培训则使用成本较低的内部搜索后端,每次培训的推出也由LLM法官评分(第3.7节)。 在8-32节点规划RL阶段的团队应分别而不是按每个阶段的平均水平来预算这些阶段。

blocks.en: Several limits bound these conclusions. The sequential stage order was shaped by earlier experiments and the compute budget; it is one that worked, not one shown to be optimal (§ 2.1 ), and we did not explore the alternative of training domain-specific experts and merging them by multi-teacher on-policy distillation [ 25 ] . Coding Agent was trained on the compute available rather than to convergence (§ 3.6 ). No single benchmark suite was tracked across every stage, so a benchmark’s movement between the stages that report it is not attributed to any one stage (§ 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: 这些结论有若干限制。 相继的阶段顺序是由先前的实验和计算预算决定的;这是一个行之有效的阶段,而不是表现为最佳阶段(第2.1节),我们没有探索培训特定领域专家并通过多教师政策提炼将其合并的替代办法[25]。 对编码代理人进行了关于可用计算而不是趋同的培训(第3.6节)。 每个阶段都没有跟踪到单一的基准套件,因此,报告阶段之间的基准变动不归因于任何一个阶段(第5.2节)。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Rufus-Air is a documented post-training recipe on the public GLM-4.5-Air-Base checkpoint: eight stages in one serial pipeline; a training stack built on open-source components; public SFT datasets, much of them used as released; RL prompt sets built from public sources and synthetic generation; and no newly commissioned human annotation. The resulting model leads the public GLM-4.5-Air release on every reported benchmark except Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing and is competitive with open models of similar size (Table 1 , § 5.2 ).
blocks.zh: Rufus-Air是公共GLM-4.5-Air-Base检查站上记录的训练后食谱:一个串行管道的八个阶段;一个基于开源组件的训练堆;公共SFT数据集,其中很多作为发布使用;RL即时集由公共来源和合成生成而成;没有新委托的人类注释. 由此产生的模型导致公共GLM-4.5-Air发布除了Arena-Hard v2 Creative Writing以外的每个报告基准,并且与大小类似的开放模型具有竞争力(表1,第5.2段)。

blocks.en: The contribution we care about is the recipe itself. Post-training is often reported at the level of a system card. This recipe is written down specifically enough for a team with tens of nodes to follow it stage by stage, or to take a single stage or infrastructure component without the rest. Because the stack builds on open-source components and the data are public, others can check the recipe and build on it. We hope they do, and report what they change.
blocks.zh: 我们关心的贡献是秘方本身。 培训后往往在系统卡一级报告。 这个配方特地写下来,让一个有数十个节点的团队可以逐级跟踪它,或者在没有其他节点的情况下采取单一的阶段或基础设施组件. 由于堆栈以开源组件为基础,并且数据是公开的,其他人可以检查食谱并在此基础上发展. 我们希望它们这样做,并报告它们的变化。

blocks.en: Beyond the numbers themselves, the following bears on how the grey columns should be read. • Agentic benchmarks are run under each source’s own harness. Qwen3.5’s BrowseComp and Seal-0 use context folding, which prunes earlier tool responses past a length threshold [ 81 ] , where ours uses a scratchpad (§ 3.7 ). The Tau2-Bench user is simulated by Qwen3-235B-A22B-2507 at Artificial Analysis [ 8 ] , by an unstated model in the NVIDIA and Solar Open reports, and by Claude Sonnet 5 in ours; that choice alone moves a cell by up to 23.7 points (Appendix F ). • NVIDIA’s Arena-Hard v2 win rates for Qwen3.5 and GPT-OSS-120B name neither the judge nor the baseline model, so they are not on the same scale as our Hard Prompt configuration (§ 5.1 ). • The Artificial Analysis figures are for the reasoning variants of Qwen3.5 and Mistral-Small-4 and the high-effort variant of GPT-OSS-120B; the non-reasoning variants score far lower. • Two benchmarks changed version under the sources. LiveCodeBench cells enter the v6 row only when the source gives a matching window: Ring-flash-2.0’s 2408–2505 is the v6 window, and Mistral-Small-4’s own 63.6 names none, so Zyphra’s 57.9 (2025-02 to 2025-05) is used. blocks.en: Appendix E Search Agent Evaluation and Trajectory Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录E 搜索代理评价和轨迹分析

blocks.en: All search benchmarks run under one harness, standardized across models and separate from the lower-cost services used in RL training. Web search uses the Google Serper API [ 88 ] (up to 10 organic results per query), page extraction uses Jina Reader [ 44 ] (pages returned as Markdown, truncated to 95K tokens), a sandboxed Python interpreter (no network or filesystem access) handles arithmetic and string manipulation, and a unified context management strategy (described below) keeps long trajectories within the context window. Models are served with a 128K context window and up to 200 tool calls per episode, and Claude Sonnet 4.5 grades final answers against the benchmark reference. Four settings pin the environment against open-web drift: searches use US-English locale settings ( gl=us , hl=en ); pages are fetched live with no caching or sharing across models, so numbers are comparable only within one evaluation window (April 2026 for the ablation below); domains that can leak benchmark answer keys are filtered from search results and refused by the scrape tool; and unreachable or timed-out pages return an error observation that the agent must recover from, with such trajectories scored normally.
blocks.zh: 所有搜索基准都采用一种方法,在各种模式之间实现标准化,并与远程培训中使用的低成本服务分开。 网页搜索使用Google Serper API [88](每个查询最多10个有机结果),页面提取使用Jina Reader [44](页面返回为Markdown,切换为95K令牌),一个沙箱Python解释器(没有网络或文件系统访问)处理算术和字符串操作,一个统一的上下文管理策略(以下描述)在上下文窗口内保持长轨迹. 模式服务有一个128K上下文窗口,每集多达200个工具呼叫,Claude Sonnet4.5级对照基准参考最终答案. 四处设置将环境定在开放网路漂移的比对上:搜索使用美英本地化设置(gl=us,hl=en);获取网页时没有缓存或跨模型共享,因此数字仅在一个评价窗口内可比较(下文中为2026年4月);能够泄露基准解答键的域从搜索结果中过滤出来,被刮伤工具拒绝;无法获取或超时的页面返回代理商必须恢复的错误观察,这种轨迹通常得分.

blocks.en: Long research tasks can span hundreds of tool calls and outgrow the context window. We compared 12 strategies across 4 families (truncation, conversation-level summarization, selective clearing, and external memory) and their combinations; external memory with a scratchpad works best: after each research round the agent records key findings, hypotheses, and open questions in a scratchpad and keeps only the current step in the active context. It is enabled on all benchmarks but only BrowseComp trajectories grow long enough to trigger it. Disabling it drops BrowseComp accuracy by 10.7 points on the same checkpoint, a larger effect than any other single choice we varied in this stage. Recent frontier releases (e.g., DeepSeek-V3.2 [ 55 ] , Kimi K2.5 [ 46 ] ) instead report BrowseComp with a discard-all strategy, which clears the history and restarts from the original query whenever the context fills, turning the token budget into repeated independent attempts; we treat that as inference-time compute scaling and evaluate a single fixed-budget trajectory to isolate trained search competence.
blocks.zh: 长时间的研究任务可以跨越数百个工具呼叫,并超越上下文窗口. 我们比较了4个家庭的12个策略(对答、对话层次的总结、选择性清理和外部记忆)及其组合;用划线板的外部记忆最有效:每次调查后,代理人都会记录关键发现、假设和开口问题。 在所有基准上都启用了它,但只有浏览Computer轨迹长得足以触发它。 在同一检查点上,它会降低10.7点的精度,这个效果比我们现阶段任何其他选择都大。 近期的前沿发布(如DeepSeek-V3.2 [55],Kimi K2.5 [46])转而报告浏览器Comp,采用全弃策略,当上下文填充时从原始查询中清除历史并重新开始,将象征性预算转化为反复的独立尝试;我们视之为推断时间计算和评价单一的固定预算轨迹,以孤立训练有素的搜索能力.

blocks.en: Table 19 reports tool usage from every evaluation trajectory. The public GLM-4.5-Air release is search-dominated and rarely reads a page (BrowseComp search:scrape = 6.4 : 1 =6.4{:}1 ): it skims snippets. By the Coding Agent checkpoint, the policy scrapes two to three times as many pages on every benchmark, shifting from skimming snippets to reading sources. Search Agent then adjusts the mix per benchmark rather than scaling everything up: on BrowseComp it adds searches at unchanged scraping, whereas on Seal-0 and HLE-Verified it searches less than its starting checkpoint and uses Python slightly more. The resulting search:scrape ratio is about 2.3:1 on BrowseComp, 1.3:1 on HLE-Verified, and 0.9:1 on Seal-0.
blocks.zh: 表19报告了每个评价轨迹中的工具使用情况。 公开的GLM-4.5-Air发布以搜索为主,很少读取一个页面(BrowseComp search:scrape = 6.4:1=6.4{:}1):它省略片段. 通过编码代理检查站,该政策在每个基准上刮出2至3倍的页数,从滑动片段转向阅读来源. 然后,搜索代理对每个基准的混合量进行调整,而不是将所有情况都放大:在浏览Comp上,它添加了未变的搜索,而在Seal-0和HLE-Verifed上,它搜索次数少于其起始检查点,并略多使用Python。 由此产生的搜索:scrape比在浏览器Comp上约为2.3:1,在HLE-Verification上约为1.3:1,在Seal-0上约为0.9:1.

blocks.en: Depth grows along the pipeline on BrowseComp (54.0 → \to 70.6 → \to 75.3 iterations), the one benchmark whose tasks reward long multi-hop chains; on Seal-0 and HLE-Verified the Search Agent checkpoint is shallower than its init (29.8 vs. 31.6 and 28.8 vs. 33.6), so its gains there come from a different call mix at lower cost rather than from more calls. On BrowseComp, depth beyond a point stops paying: accuracy is 88% for trajectories that finish within 25 iterations, 64% for 25–50, and below 30% beyond 50; wrong answers come from trajectories more than twice as deep as correct ones (92 vs. 43 iterations); and about 10% of trajectories per run end by exhausting the token budget or overflowing the context window, essentially none of them correct. Past roughly 50 iterations, additional depth signals a stuck search rather than progress.
blocks.zh: 深度沿着浏览器Comp上的管道(54.0 → oto 70.6 → o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o o 在浏览孔普中,超过点的深度停止支付:完成25次迭代的轨迹精确度为88%,完成25-50次的轨迹精确度为64%,超过50次的轨迹精确度为30%;错误的答案来自轨迹深度的两倍以上(92对43次迭代);通过耗尽象征性预算或溢出上下文窗口,每个轨迹末端大约10%的轨迹准确度,基本上都无一正确。 过去大约50次迭代, 额外的深度表示一个卡住了的搜索而不是进步。

blocks.zh: 附录 F Tau2- 带不同用户模拟器的奔驰

blocks.en: Every Tau2-Bench episode involves a simulated customer, making the user simulator part of the evaluation protocol. Table 20 evaluates four models across three domains under three user simulators. The Rufus-Air column is an earlier checkpoint, not the final one in Table 1 ; the final checkpoint was evaluated under Sonnet 5 only (85.3 / 84.0 / 93.0), so this column shows how the scores move with the simulator rather than the final model’s numbers. Changing the simulator shifts scores by up to 23.7 23.7 points (GLM-4.5-Air on retail: 57.0 57.0 under Sonnet 4 versus 80.7 80.7 under Sonnet 5), with Sonnet 5 yielding the highest scores in all twelve model–domain pairs. These differences highlight the need to match simulator settings when comparing results across papers. Rankings are more stable: the full ordering is unchanged in telecom, and Rufus-Air ranks first in retail under all three simulators, albeit by only 0.2 0.2 points under Sonnet 5. The airline leader varies: Nemotron-3-Super leads under Sonnet 4 and Sonnet 5, while Rufus-Air leads under Sonnet 4.5.
